headline: Resort Barista and Server
summary: Barista and server with three years at a mountain resort in Kalinga. I make coffee and drinks from local beans, serve guests at the table and help at the front desk and with bookings when the resort is busy. I enjoy talking with guests about Kalinga coffee.

experience.title: Barista and Server
experience.paragraph: Part of a small team running the café and dining room of a 25-room resort.
bullets: Prepare espresso, pour-over and native Kalinga coffee drinks for up to 150 guests a day.
Serve breakfast and dinner at the table and recommend local dishes and coffees.
Follow food safety rules for milk, pastries and the dining room.
Cover the front desk and take room reservations during peak weekends.
Welcome arriving guests with a coffee and help them with check-in.

experience.title: Service Crew
bullets: Took orders and served drinks and pastries at the counter.
Kept tables and the service area clean.

skills: Barista skills: espresso and brewed coffee

education.credential: Food and Beverage Services NC II
